text: T-171 proved the pivot-prefix route kernel can use compact CSR postings and preallocated scratch with zero hot query allocations.
T-172 compacted prefix postings around u16 row IDs and validated uint16 dense l_inf signatures as the preferred fallback layout.
T-173 scale validation was NO-GO for prefix8/block64 at K10000: coverage fell short and the route planner needs fallback to prefix12 or block32/top128.
T-174 reframed Aperon as agent-native Memory SSTable: immutable semantic segments, manifests, symbol/time/provenance filters, recall traces, and compaction later.
T-175 built the in-memory Memory SSTable prototype with record columns, text bytes, embeddings, symbol postings, scope/time filters, semantic rerank, and trace output.
Unrelated operations note for another scope; it should be pruned by the demo query scope filter.
